issue.body:
The complete original Basciano and Peterson2007 article, DOI10.2138/am.2007.2432, is acquired and inspected. The qualified hydroniumjarosite record retains several internal conflicts: Table1 sampleA trace potassium is rounded out of its printed formula; natural sample7-13-2-1 formula/site entries differ across Tables1,3,4; and sulfate/reagent formula tokens differ between the methods and table heading. Table3 refines hydronium occupancy to0.92(1), distinct from full iron occupancy; H3O hydrogen positions were not determined directly.

Seek a published correction, original analytical/refinement data or other primary clarification that maps each composition and site value to the actual sample and normalization. Preserve the original values; do not correct by majority vote or charge-balance reconstruction. Any stronger natural-endmember or hydrogen-site claim must be checked against the complete later Plášil2014 original (DOI10.1180/minmag.2014.078.3.04), which is currently only an indexed-text/metadata lead in this investigation.

Acceptance requires claim-level authoritative provenance and an explicit sample/version crosswalk. The accepted owner can retain its bounded abiotic formation and natural-occurrence statements while these questions remain open. Neither a corrected formula nor phase identification would establish microbial causality, recovered iron efficiency or industrial performance. No author contact is requested.
issue.title: Clarify formula and site-occupancy discrepancies in Basciano2007 hydroniumjarosite

scope: Source clarification distinct from record correction; accepted claims already bounded. No external author contact.
